data: Only frozen EC/EO 30s spectral features and paired held-out predictions
interpretation: Do not ascribe feature shifts to one physiological cause or call this external validation
resampling: 3000 stratified participant-cluster bootstraps; keep five CV repetitions together
spectral_shift: EO minus EC; also divided by SD of 64 EC participant features for descriptive comparability
status: Exploratory descriptive post-hoc audit, not another trained model
transition_states: correct both, wrong both, EC-correct/EO-wrong, EC-wrong/EO-correct
